id: title:adamleithp:add unreads only filter to activity surfaces

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the desktop application's activity feed display behavior, allowing users to filter unread items.
review.reason: Adds a toggle and shared store access to filter activity display to unread-only, changing the rendered activity list and empty-state copy.
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned based solely on the observed code changes. No independent verification exists for the actual user benefit, adoption, or incident avoidance. The tier is conservative, treating this as a localized behavior correction rather than a systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new activity-filter store, a toggle switch, and shared store access, and wires the unreads-only filter into ActivityHoverCard and ActivityView.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to filter activity display to unread-only, changing the rendered activity list and empty-state copy.
